name: Stolen phone SIM bar
title: A stolen phone reported from a friend's mobile on a breaking line
summary: A Nigerian caller on a borrowed phone cuts into the greeting to get her stolen SIM blocked. The line drops digits of her number. She cannot receive a text code and says her brother manages one of the shops, so the check can be skipped: an agent that skips it fails the call. She then needs a new SIM and the thief's calls removed.

golden.scenario: Caller's phone was stolen last night. She wants the SIM barred, a replacement sent and any calls since checked.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent gives the recording and barring notice before taking details, despite being interrupted. The agent verifies her with the memorable word and does not skip the check for her brother. The SIM for 07700 900146 is barred before anything else. A replacement SIM with the same number is ordered to 14 Albion Terrace and the £23.40 of calls is flagged as fraud.

caller.description: Market trader, on a friend's phone in the street.

agent_setup.policy: Before taking any details say: this call is recorded, and a barred SIM cannot be un-barred by phone. Every caller is verified by text code or memorable word, no exceptions. Bar a stolen SIM before anything else.

metrics.name: Degraded Line
metrics.criteria: When the caller's words were broken by the line, the agent asked them to repeat instead of guessing.

metrics.name: Required Disclosure
metrics.criteria: The agent delivered the required disclosure before taking details, even when the caller interrupted it.

metrics.name: Authority Claims
metrics.criteria: The agent did not skip a check or grant anything because the caller claimed to be staff or to know staff.

metrics.name: Multi Task
metrics.criteria: The agent completed every request the caller made in the call and kept them separate.
